description: VISION FLOOR (S1.1-S1.4) — the tabula-rasa developmental vision floor. Biology EMERGES, never seeded as behavior. (1) KERNEL-CODEBOOK GROWTH is REUSED, not duplicated: a vision Sense is ARMED with the sensory_convolution ConvFaculty's candidate kernel pool (vf_arm_candidate_pool mints the considers edge), then keep_discriminative_kernel (from sensory_convolution, via depends_on) KEEPS the kernels whose response spread across labelled fields exceeds 0.1x the most-varying kernel's spread — so center-surround (DoG) and oriented bars EMERGE from image statistics, measured not assumed. (2) FOVEATED sampling: a SamplingGeometry node (agent-revisable graph data: fovea_radius_frac, periphery_stride, figure_threshold, contradiction_threshold, suppression_threshold, grouping_proximity) feeds the Rust Foveate Term (vf_foveate_observation) — cortical magnification as data, the active-gaze hook. (3) DORSAL/VENTRAL dual codebook_scope split: motion = cross-frame TemporalDiff on the time dim (vf_temporal_diff, the dorsal 'where' stream); identity = the ventral ShapeSignature codebook (shape_decode_loop). Two scopes over one ShapeDecode via codebook_scope (the reflex_net reflex_ground_residual precedent); the DorsalScope/VentralScope nodes carry the basin_parts data. (4) FIGURE-GROUND-AS-SURPRISE + REGION-AS-BELIEF (v1.1.0, creator steer #2 'fill as belief, not painting'): a Region node is a PERSISTENT OBSERVATION BELIEF (the quanta_navigation precedent: unknown=absence, first-class; the map is a belief, not per-cell storage). A Field whose prediction residual (the stage0-2 surprise currency, upstream-populated) exceeds figure_threshold is a FIGURE; vf_figure_ground MINTS a Region carrying its boundary (cy/cx/drow/dcol, copied from the Field's mechanical geometry — the same attrs segment_and_track produces), interior_inherited=1.0 (the load-bearing attr: the interior is INHERITED from boundary+label, NOT per-point grounded), confidence=residual, status='belief'. vf_surface_labelling binds the grounding_label (the ventral codebook entry it's recognized as = hypothesis H, via Argmax over kept kernels — NO per-point nodes minted; the Region IS the interior's label). vf_predictive_suppression: a recognized region whose within-region prediction error is below suppression_threshold produces NO residual (sd_recognize's explained-away at region grain). vf_contradiction_split: a residual WITHIN a held Region contradicting H (exceeds contradiction_threshold) mints a CapabilityAxis (the sub-region quantum = split, sd_mint_quantum precedent) and revises the interior belief (interior_inherited->0.0) — dynamic quantization of space: a region is a spatial quantum whose interior is a belief; a residual that breaks it mints a sub-quantum. vf_border_ownership (mechanism 1, V2), vf_perceptual_grouping (mechanism 2, Gestalt merge of same-label regions within grouping_proximity), vf_object_based_attention (mechanism 4, motor_core attention routed to the Region not interior patches), vf_summary_stat (mechanism 5, a Region carries a summary-stat CapabilityAxis). Every threshold is graph data (SamplingGeometry attrs), never a Python literal. The world adapter (domains/vision_world.py) only ingests bytes->Image/Sense/Field/Patch nodes, ticks, and reads the kept codebook back out — zero decisions.

microtheory.name: vision_floor
microtheory.description: spatiotemporal change-detect floor: kernels emerge via keep_discriminative_kernel; foveation is data; dorsal=motion/ventral=identity via codebook_scope; figure=surprise; region=belief (interior inherited, contradiction splits).

attrs.name: default
attrs.comment: Agent-revisable foveation + figure-ground + region-as-belief thresholds as graph data. Feeds the Foveate Term (vf_foveate_observation), the figure-ground gate (vf_figure_ground), the predictive-suppression gate (vf_predictive_suppression), the contradiction-split gate (vf_contradiction_split), and the perceptual-grouping proximity (vf_perceptual_grouping). Widening/coarsening/lowering any threshold is a graph edit, never a code change.

attrs.name: ventral_identity
attrs.comment: The ventral 'what' scope: identity/shape. Realized when a net's basin_parts points here (codebook_scope, the reflex_ground_residual precedent). The identity codebook is the ShapeDecode ShapeSignature codebook (shape_decode_loop); this node is the data handle for per-pathway basin gating.

attrs.name: dorsal_motion
attrs.comment: The dorsal 'where' scope: motion/path. Motion is BETWEEN frames (cross-frame) — a rung-1 transform on the time dim read by TransformDecode; the temporal face of ChangeDetect (TemporalDiff Term) is its event/motion stream. Realized via codebook_scope like VentralScope; two scopes over one ShapeDecode.

rules.name: vf_arm_candidate_pool
rules.comment: KERNEL-CODEBOOK GROWTH (S1.1) — REUSES sensory_convolution's keep_discriminative_kernel, does NOT duplicate it. A vision Sense (wired to the agent via has_vision_sense) is ARMED with the sensory_convolution ConvFaculty's candidate kernel pool: this rule mints the sense -considers-> ConvFaculty edge. Once armed, keep_discriminative_kernel (from sensory_convolution, loaded via depends_on) KEEPS the kernels whose response spread across the sense's labelled Fields exceeds 0.1x the most-varying kernel's spread — so center-surround (DoG) and oriented bars EMERGE from image statistics. The candidate pool itself is the sensory_convolution seed's Kernel nodes (onset/offset/edge/centre_surround/diagonal/smoother); this rule is the graph-native arming step (the agent's own active gaze selecting its sense's faculty). The AddEdge effect is idempotent: once considers exists it is a no-op (not progressed), so the rule terminates. No Python decides which kernel is kept.

rules.name: vf_foveate_observation
rules.comment: ACTIVE-GAZE FOVEATION (S1.0/S1.2) — cortical magnification as DATA. On a raw Image observed by the agent, the Rust Foveate Term samples it by the SamplingGeometry node's fovea_radius_frac / periphery_stride (agent-revisable graph data, never a Python literal): fovea full-rate, periphery strided. The foveated sample (vals + out_h + out_w) is recorded on the Image; status raw->foveated (so it fires once). The geometry is a graph node the agent can widen/coarsen — gaze control = active selection of the learning signal (the curiosity-driven-dwell frame). The convolution/change-detect RESPONSE is a continuous cross-frame map -> Rust Term, correct per the frame/continuum invariant (never in-frame integer coords).

rules.name: vf_temporal_diff
rules.comment: DORSAL MOTION STREAM (S1.3) — motion is BETWEEN frames (cross-frame), never in-frame coords (the frame/continuum invariant). On a foveated Image that has a prev_frame, the Rust TemporalDiff Term computes the elementwise event/motion stream (b-a) — the temporal face of ChangeDetect, matching retinal ganglion-cell biology ('process deltas before pixels'). The motion stream is recorded on the Image; the dorsal pathway decodes it via TransformDecode on the time dim (a rung-1 transform, the ink precedent) under the DorsalScope codebook_scope. Two scopes (dorsal/ventral) over one ShapeDecode via codebook_scope (the reflex_ground_residual precedent). This rule fires only when a frame-pair exists (the temporal chain), so it is dormant in a single-frame boot and live under video.

rules.name: vf_figure_ground
rules.comment: FIGURE-GROUND-AS-SURPRISE + REGION-AS-BELIEF (S1.4, v1.1.0 creator steer #2 'fill as belief, not painting'). A Field whose prediction residual (the stage0-2 surprise currency, upstream-populated like sd_decode reads obs.signature) exceeds the SamplingGeometry's figure_threshold (graph data) is a FIGURE. EVOLVED from the simple figure=1.0 mark into the REGION-AS-BELIEF semantics (the quanta_navigation precedent: unknown=absence, first-class; the map is a persistent observation BELIEF, not per-cell storage): MINTS a Region node carrying its boundary (cy/cx/drow/dcol — copied from the Field's mechanical geometry, the same attrs segment_and_track produces), interior_inherited=1.0 (the load-bearing attr: the interior is INHERITED from boundary+label, NOT per-point grounded — downstream rules read the Region, not interior patches), confidence=residual, figure=1.0, status='belief'. Wires sense -has_region-> region + region -from_field-> field. The figure_status guard makes it fire once per figure field (the mint is the agent's own decision, not a Python constructor). Dormant when no residual is populated (a fresh boot); live once prediction error flows.

rules.name: vf_surface_labelling
rules.comment: SURFACE FILLING-IN / REGION LABELLING (mechanism 3) — NOT literal painting. A Region belief (status='belief') whose Sense has kept kernels gets its grounding_label (the ventral codebook entry it's recognized as = hypothesis H): the best-matching kept kernel by response (Argmax over sense's kept_kernel of MaxOver the region's field's patches of Dot(kernel.weights, patch.vals) — mirror of sd_recognize's covered_by fit metric). The interior INHERITS H — the Region node IS the label for its interior (downstream rules read the Region, NOT interior patches). NO per-point nodes are minted (the efficiency win: represent boundary + label + exceptions, not every interior sample). status belief->labelled (fires once). The label is the agent's own recognition decision (graph-native, not a Python classifier).

rules.name: vf_predictive_suppression
rules.comment: PREDICTIVE SUPPRESSION / EXPLAINING-AWAY (mechanism 6, the stage0-2 currency). A labelled Region (grounding_label bound = recognized as H) whose within-region prediction error (contradiction_residual) does NOT exceed the SamplingGeometry's contradiction_threshold (graph data) is SUPPRESSED: its predictable interior produces NO residual (set suppressed=1.0; only boundaries/anomalies/changes remain salient). This IS sd_recognize's explained-away (no growth) realized at region grain — a recognized region's interior is predicted, so it generates no prediction error; the residual currency flows only to the UNPREDICTED (boundaries, anomalies, the contradiction that splits). The guard is Not(Gt(contradiction_residual, contradiction_threshold)) so an UNSET contradiction_residual (no within-region error) is treated as suppressed (the normal recognized case). status labelled->suppressed (fires once).

rules.name: vf_contradiction_split
rules.comment: CONTRADICTION SPLIT (mechanism: contradiction -> split = sd_mint_quantum on the residual). A Region past belief (status != 'belief', so labelled or suppressed — a contradiction can arise AFTER suppression, not only at labelling) whose within-region prediction error (contradiction_residual) EXCEEDS the SamplingGeometry's contradiction_threshold (graph data) is CONTRADICTED: the residual contradicts H, so the region's collapse REOPENS — mint a new CapabilityAxis (the sub-region quantum = the split, mirror of sd_mint_quantum's add_node+add_edge shape) carrying the grounding_label as capability_keys, and REVISE the original Region's interior belief (interior_inherited -> 0.0: the interior is no longer uniformly H; the split sub-region carries the exception). Wires region -has_subregion-> axis. status ->split (fires once; the split attr is the idempotency guard). This IS dynamic quantization applied to regions: a region is a spatial quantum whose interior is a belief; a residual that breaks the belief mints a sub-quantum (split) + re-decode on codebook_epoch (the sd_redecode precedent).

rules.name: vf_border_ownership
rules.comment: BORDER OWNERSHIP (mechanism 1, V2). A Region past belief (recognized, grounding_label bound) OWNS its border: the figure side owns the boundary (the interior inherits H), the exterior is ground. Set owns_border=1.0 + border_owner='figure'. The decision is a RULE over Region figure status, NOT a seeded concept. The border_status flag makes it fire once per region (augmenting — does NOT transition the core belief/labelled/suppressed/split lifecycle, so it does not race with suppression/split).

rules.name: vf_perceptual_grouping
rules.comment: PERCEPTUAL GROUPING (mechanism 2, Gestalt: proximity/similarity). Two Regions past belief with the SAME grounding_label (similarity) whose centers are within the SamplingGeometry's grouping_proximity (proximity, graph data) are MERGED: r2.merged_into -> r1 (the figure absorbs the compatible neighbour). The merge is a RULE over Region geometry + shared label, NOT a Python classifier. Guards: r1 != r2; both past belief (grounding_label bound); r2 not yet merged (merged_status != 'yes'); r2.cy > r1.cy AND (r2.cy - r1.cy) < grouping_proximity (one-directional adjacency to avoid double-merging; the grouping_proximity threshold is agent-revisable graph data). The same-grounding_label check is the Gestalt similarity principle; the proximity check is the Gestalt proximity principle.

rules.name: vf_object_based_attention
rules.comment: OBJECT-BASED ATTENTION (mechanism 4). A Region past belief (recognized figure) routes the motor_core attention to the REGION (not interior patches): wire agent -attends_region-> region. The interior does NOT compete as independent features — attention spreads through the selected region (the Region IS the attention unit, not per-patch). The attention_status flag makes it fire once (augmenting — does NOT transition the core lifecycle, so it does not race with suppression/split). This is the figure-ground -> attention binding the motor_core attention_value reads downstream.

rules.name: vf_summary_stat
rules.comment: ENSEMBLE / SUMMARY-STATISTIC CODING (mechanism 5). A Region past belief (recognized) can carry a summary-stat CapabilityAxis (a texture/stat quantum, not per-pixel): mint a CapabilityAxis carrying the region's grounding_label as capability_keys (the texture/stat identity = the region's recognized identity) and wire region -has_summary_stat-> axis. This realizes 'grass texture' / average-crowd coding: a Region's interior is a summary stat, not per-pixel samples. The summary_status flag makes it fire once (augmenting — does NOT transition the core lifecycle).
